name: Teo's Kitchen
notes: 3 photos: a printed breakfast board, a printed salads board, and a chalkboard behind the counter listing burritos/quesadillas/daily specials. Chalkboard is handwritten and partly cut off at the frame edges, so a taco/appetizer row at top and a couple of items (Oriental Chicken salad, a handwritten 'NEW ___ Burrito') were dropped as illegible; one breakfast item was physically blacked out on the board and dropped.
